query:
SELECT u.is_admin,
               ($2::bigint IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM token t
                   WHERE t.id = $2 AND t.user_id = u.id AND t.revoked_at IS NULL
                     AND (t.expires_at IS NULL OR t.expires_at > now())
               )) AS "token_live!"
        FROM app_user u
        WHERE u.id = $1 AND u.active
